Dana, I saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki (subject "Quarrendon 2026 rate") in your drafts, but it has a placeholder where the rate goes, not $2,356. Rates going to someone outside the account team need approval, so I asked June Osei-Lark, and the draft stays unsent until she signs off.

The signed 2026 Renewal Order Form shows USD 1,920 list less 10%, which is USD 1,728 per seat. That doesn't match $2,356, so please check the figure with June before it goes in.
